mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents (title, source, content, content_type, chunk_count, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{source}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{chunkCount}, #{createdBy}, datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, source, content, content_type AS contentType, chunk_count AS chunkCount, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM documents WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, source, content, content_type AS contentType, chunk_count AS chunkCount, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM documents ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, title, source, content, content_type AS contentType, chunk_count AS chunkCount, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM documents WHERE created_by = #{email} ORDER BY created_at DESC
